# Iman Bachat

> Full-stack web developer based in Tripoli, Lebanon. I build websites that bring small businesses clients, and the WhatsApp AI behind them that answers customers, takes bookings and orders, and logs every detail automatically. I work with clients in Lebanon, the United Arab Emirates, Australia and Canada, in Arabic and English.

## Services
- Website design and development: landing pages and business websites built to turn visitors into inquiries, in Arabic and English (no-code or custom-coded).
- SEO and Google Business Profile: so local customers find the business on Google Search and Maps.
- WhatsApp AI chatbot: an AI assistant on the business's own WhatsApp number that answers questions, takes bookings and orders, confirms them, and hands unclear messages to a person.
- Dashboards and automation: order, booking and client dashboards that remove manual data entry.
- Monthly support: hosting, small edits and monitoring of the AI after launch.

## Who it is for
Clinics, law offices, consultants, restaurants, delivery businesses, shops and other service businesses that get clients through inquiries, bookings or orders.

## Selected work
- 360 Services (delivery company, Lebanon): WhatsApp AI that reads orders from a busy WhatsApp group and logs area, items and payment automatically; 80–90% of manual order handling automated.
- Kings Entertainment Group (Sydney, Australia): website with reservation form, SEO and Google Business Profile for a Lebanese Zaffe and Dabke performance group.
- Ichrakieh Law Office (Tripoli, Lebanon): bilingual Arabic/English website for a law office established in 1965.
- Farah Salhab (gender and inclusion consultant, MENA): personal brand website redesign with SEO.

## Background
Before freelancing, Iman ran operations for a delivery company (HR, finance, orders and the call center). Master's in Computer & Communication Engineering, Lebanese International University. 4+ years of experience, 15+ projects delivered.
